source_evidence:
Day330~21:06 exact player 'Sigh… unfortunately they did not actually attack us or pursue threats… 

Let a guard know what they look like and hopefully the law can help' chooses no pursuit or attack and authorizes ordinary report to local lawful authority. The withdrawing six men disappear westward along road into darkness; no pursuit or subsequent location established. Freed woman tells party there is a nearby hamlet about half a mile back toward Orsaven, with resident local constable and relatives who can shelter both adults. This is newly introduced local knowledge, not a new random encounter or claim of permanent security. After ordinary water and rest by fire, man is able to walk with support; no HP damage, healing roll, spell, exhaustion level, payment, or food charge established. At Cirren's own suggestion, Cirren and willing Fenar accompany the consenting adults along the known eastern road to the hamlet, while V and Mara remain at existing camp with coach/four horses; no V movement, speech, promise, or resource expense assumed. Constable receives both adults' firsthand account and Cirren/Fenar's descriptions, approximate group size six, two restrained victims, contradictory silver claim and westward withdrawal. He records report and intends to notify neighboring authorities/reeve; no verified pursuit, detention, identification or outcome. Both freed adults elect to stay with their relatives in hamlet rather than immediately return to their farm; constable knows their account and shelter location. No assertion that captives remain indefinitely safe. Cirren and Fenar return together to the camp about22:10 and confirm actual report received and adults with relatives. Entire party reunited, no additional encounter check this night (D330 random encounter already occurred); no new dice because ordinary local directions, willing report, familiar short walk and cooperative official, not a contested identification or enforcement action. No further night rest yet adjudicated; V chooses next action. No new financial, resource, inventory, estate, diplomatic, quest payment or custody change.
